models_evaluated: 21 representative models (LLMs, vision-language models, time-series language models, physiological signal foundation models; individual names not given in text)

links.outcome: Sensitivity of model performance to question formulation (input wording variation)
links.effect: Performance remains sensitive to question formulation; no model achieved consistently strong performance across modalities and tasks. No numbers given in the abstract.
links.quote: The incorporation of natural language supports unified prediction across tasks, although performance remains sensitive to question formulation.

unlisted_practices: Harmonizing public physiological signal annotations into a unified question-answering benchmark for cross-task, cross-modality model evaluation

screen.reason: The paper introduces PhysioBench, a benchmark for evaluating multimodal foundation models and LLMs on physiological signal question answering across multiple datasets.
